PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 208V, C1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, CSA
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, C1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, CSA
PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, C1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, CSA
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, D1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, 16 Segments, CSA
PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, D1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, 16 Segments, CSA
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

DESCRIPTION:
Celltreat Ovation® pipettes have a unique and patented ergonomic design. They are the only pipettes that fully address the issues of posture, repetition, and force to significantly reduce strain and pain that occur from pipetting, while always providing superior accuracy and precision.
The angled shape allows users to pipette with low arm and elbow height, decreasing tension and associated pain in the neck, shoulder, back, and elbow. When used properly, the Ovation pipette will keep the users hand and wrist in the neutral position recommended by ergonomic experts.
• Contoured body shape and adjustable hook assures a comfortable, easy grip, and custom fit hand hold
• Spring-loaded tip acquisition means a gentle push is all that is required to attach tips, and an audible click confirms secure attachment
• Tips flick off easily with a low force push of the eject button
• Special filters in the nozzle prevent liquid from being inadvertently aspirated into the pipettor, protecting it from contamination
• Ovation pipettes are the only pipettes that stand on their own, which means tips never touch the bench, even if the pipette is put down in the middle of a procedure
• Mechanical models feature two-stroke operation, available with click stop or quick set digital volume adjustment (0.2µL - 1000µL)
• Electronic models feature custom volume presets, multi-dispensing, mixing, and serial diluting (0.5µL - 1250µL)
• Electronic Macro 5mL and 10mL, and electronic 8 and 12 multichannel models available
• Single channel models include a built-in micro tube cap opener
• Color-coded for easy and quick volume identification

PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, B1 Digital Single Setpoint with Ramp and Dwell, CSA/CE
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)

DESCRIPTION:
Celltreat Ovation® pipettes have a unique and patented ergonomic design. They are the only pipettes that fully address the issues of posture, repetition, and force to significantly reduce strain and pain that occur from pipetting, while always providing superior accuracy and precision.
The angled shape allows users to pipette with low arm and elbow height, decreasing tension and associated pain in the neck, shoulder, back, and elbow. When used properly, the Ovation pipette will keep the users hand and wrist in the neutral position recommended by ergonomic experts.
• Contoured body shape and adjustable hook assures a comfortable, easy grip, and custom fit hand hold
• Spring-loaded tip acquisition means a gentle push is all that is required to attach tips, and an audible click confirms secure attachment
• Tips flick off easily with a low force push of the eject button
• Special filters in the nozzle prevent liquid from being inadvertently aspirated into the pipettor, protecting it from contamination
• Ovation pipettes are the only pipettes that stand on their own, which means tips never touch the bench, even if the pipette is put down in the middle of a procedure
• Mechanical models feature two-stroke operation, available with click stop or quick set digital volume adjustment (0.2µL - 1000µL)
• Electronic models feature custom volume presets, multi-dispensing, mixing, and serial diluting (0.5µL - 1250µL)
• Electronic Macro 5mL and 10mL, and electronic 8 and 12 multichannel models available
• Single channel models include a built-in micro tube cap opener
• Color-coded for easy and quick volume identification

DESCRIPTION:

• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit

• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens

DESCRIPTION:
Celltreat Ovation® pipettes have a unique and patented ergonomic design. They are the only pipettes that fully address the issues of posture, repetition, and force to significantly reduce strain and pain that occur from pipetting, while always providing superior accuracy and precision.

• Electronic Macro 5mL and 10mL, and electronic 8 and 12 multichannel models available

• Color-coded for easy and quick volume identification

DESCRIPTION:
Celltreat Ovation® pipettes have a unique and patented ergonomic design. They are the only pipettes that fully address the issues of posture, repetition, and force to significantly reduce strain and pain that occur from pipetting, while always providing superior accuracy and precision.
The angled shape allows users to pipette with low arm and elbow height, decreasing tension and associated pain in the neck, shoulder, back, and elbow. When used properly, the Ovation pipette will keep the users hand and wrist in the neutral position recommended by ergonomic experts.
• Contoured body shape and adjustable hook assures a comfortable, easy grip, and custom fit hand hold
• Spring-loaded tip acquisition means a gentle push is all that is required to attach tips, and an audible click confirms secure attachment
• Tips flick off easily with a low force push of the eject button
• Special filters in the nozzle prevent liquid from being inadvertently aspirated into the pipettor, protecting it from contamination
• Ovation pipettes are the only pipettes that stand on their own, which means tips never touch the bench, even if the pipette is put down in the middle of a procedure
• Mechanical models feature two-stroke operation, available with click stop or quick set digital volume adjustment (0.2µL - 1000µL)
• Electronic models feature custom volume presets, multi-dispensing, mixing, and serial diluting (0.5µL - 1250µL)
• Electronic Macro 5mL and 10mL, and electronic 8 and 12 multichannel models available
• Single channel models include a built-in micro tube cap opener
• Color-coded for easy and quick volume identification

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, C1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, CSA/CE
PRODUCT_NAME: Thermo Scientific Thermolyne Premium Large Muffle Furnace, 240V, C1 Digital Programmable with 4 Programs, CSA/CE
DESCRIPTION:
Conduct industrial applications including ashing organic and inorganic samples and conducting gravimetric analysis with Thermo Scientific™ Thermolyne™ Premium Large Muffle Furnaces. Models F6010 and F6018 include a cord and plug set. All except Models F6010 and F6018 require a conduit connection.

Key Features:
• Four heating elements are located on the chamber top, bottom and sides for enhanced temperature uniformity
• Built-in vent port removes undesirable contaminants and moisture to extend the life of the element and unit
• Rear of the chamber incorporates a 0.95 cm (0.38 in.) dia. port for monitoring chamber temperatures with independent measuring devices
• Optional stainless steel shelf doubles load capacity (maximum temperature of 900 DEG C)
• Door safety switch stops power to heating elements when door opens
• Thermocouple break protection cuts power to the heating elements, preventing a thermocouple failure runaway condition
• Furnaces with B1, C1, and D1 control also use a mechanical overtemperature protection relay

Choice of Temperature Controllers:
• Digital single setpoint control (A1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital single setpoint control with single ramp to setpoint and a dwell (B1): Single display shows actual temperature or setpoint
• Digital programmable control with one stored program of eight segments (C1)
• Digital programmable control with four stored programs, 16 segments per program (D1): Controller includes RS-232 communications

Specifications:
• Chamber capacity cu. ft (L): 0.5 (14)
• Maximum temperature °C (°F): 1200 (2192)
• Chamber dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 12.8 x 10 x 6.8 (33 x 25 x 18)
• Overall dim. W x D x H in. (cm): 19.1 x 29.5 x 21 (48.5 x 74.9 x 53.3)
• Ship. weight lbs (kg): 110 (49.8)
†U.S. and Canada Sales Only

PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: 1-10uL Pipette, Ovation, Quick-Set (QS), Fits 10/20uL LfTS Tips
PRODUCT_NAME: 1-10uL Pipette, Ovation, Quick-Set (QS), Fits 10/20uL LfTS Tips
DESCRIPTION:
Celltreat Ovation® pipettes have a unique and patented ergonomic design. They are the only pipettes that fully address the issues of posture, repetition, and force to significantly reduce strain and pain that occur from pipetting, while always providing superior accuracy and precision.
The angled shape allows users to pipette with low arm and elbow height, decreasing tension and associated pain in the neck, shoulder, back, and elbow. When used properly, the Ovation pipette will keep the users hand and wrist in the neutral position recommended by ergonomic experts.
• Contoured body shape and adjustable hook assures a comfortable, easy grip, and custom fit hand hold
• Spring-loaded tip acquisition means a gentle push is all that is required to attach tips, and an audible click confirms secure attachment
• Tips flick off easily with a low force push of the eject button
• Special filters in the nozzle prevent liquid from being inadvertently aspirated into the pipettor, protecting it from contamination
• Ovation pipettes are the only pipettes that stand on their own, which means tips never touch the bench, even if the pipette is put down in the middle of a procedure
• Mechanical models feature two-stroke operation, available with click stop or quick set digital volume adjustment (0.2µL - 1000µL)
• Electronic models feature custom volume presets, multi-dispensing, mixing, and serial diluting (0.5µL - 1250µL)
• Electronic Macro 5mL and 10mL, and electronic 8 and 12 multichannel models available
• Single channel models include a built-in micro tube cap opener
• Color-coded for easy and quick volume identification
Image(s) are representative of the product group and not necessarily the individual product.

DESCRIPTION: Calculates SPL and L EQ  Sper Scientific’s Integrating Sound Datalogger measures sound pressure level (SPL) according to A or C weighting and integrates the weighted SPL over an established length of time, such as an 8-hour workday, to calculate cumulative sound exposure (LEQ). Test parameters are simultaneously displayed on a large, bright, backlit display, featuring 0.1 dB resolution and a bar graph. Up to 64,000 data records can be stored in the meter, saved, graphed, and processed on a computer through the USB interface and included software. The bidirectional USB port and software also enable control of the meter via its on-screen image. Features include SPL and LEQ sound level readings, fast and slow time weighting, A and C frequency weightings, and over-limit and under-limit alarms. A single dynamic 30 to 130 dB range eliminates the need to manually select ranges and prevents data errors during range changes in auto-ranging models. The meter complies with IEC 6167
